questions.funFact: Han was born on 23 July 2025, which is also Ian and Jane’s wedding anniversary.
Ian and Jane hope Han will grow up intelligent, strong and elegant, just like his name.
Han arrived at exactly 8:13 in the morning, creating one of the happiest moments in Ian and Jane’s lives.
Han was born on 23 July, making him a Leo.

questions.prompt: Who gave Han his very first bath?
questions.funFact: The “stranger” was actually a lovely nurse at the hospital who gave Han his very first bath.

questions.prompt: How old was Han when his first teeth came through?
questions.funFact: Han did not get just one first tooth—four teeth came through at the same time.

questions.prompt: What does Han do when he stands under the shower?

answers.label: Enjoy it and stick out his tongue to catch the water

questions.funFact: Han loves standing under the shower and sticks out his tongue to catch the water as if it were a game.

questions.prompt: Who does Han look for when he gets sleepy?
questions.funFact: When Han feels sleepy, Mum is usually the person he looks for to feel safe and comfortable.

questions.prompt: What does Han do whenever he hears the song “Bingo”?
questions.funFact: Whenever “Bingo” starts playing, Han almost always begins clapping along to the music.

questions.prompt: What is Ian and Jane’s biggest wish for Han?

answers.label: Grow up healthy, kind and happy

questions.funFact: Thank you for celebrating Han’s very first birthday with us. We hope he grows up surrounded by love, laughter and wonderful people—just like today.
